title: qa(checklist): no clause drives the fresh-install order #24827 fixed — `os migrate apply` first on an empty database writes the organization-ownership birth marker, so the first `os serve` boots instead of refusing
body:
**Filing gate ②: a coverage gap in the platform checklist, measured.** **Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat (`docs/qa/**`), in one checklist PR. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (`os-warren`, `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, seat post #6023) at the close of the 18.0 sweep anchor #24579, with the maintainer's agreement in this session's chat (「同意立卡」). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## The gap

- **The fix:** #24827 (closed) fixed a p1: `os migrate apply` as the first command on an empty database wrote no organization-ownership birth marker, so the fresh install's first `os serve` was refused as a 17.x / 18.0 pre-release database. The fix is pending on `main` as `.changeset/24827-migrate-apply-birth-marker.md` (minor), so it ships in **18.1.0**.
- **The gap:** QA round 4 (#24838) found that no checklist item drives that order live. Round 16 of #24579 confirmed it: `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` scopes a 17.x-shaped database, and its history row says the order "is not added here" (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`).
- **Already covered elsewhere:** the shape-generation-0 refusal is a clause of `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` acceptance[5] since round 16.

## Wanted

- Find the item whose scope covers a fresh install's first boot, or author one with the `checklist-author` skill if none does.
- The clause drives the order on an empty database: `os migrate apply` first, then `os serve`. Its oracle is the boot: the server reaches its serving line, with no ownership refusal.
- Read the marker the apply wrote at its own layer (the `sys_migration` row `adr-0131-organization-ownership`).
- The clause names the release that carries the fix (18.1.0). Until a published release carries it, a run against 18.0.0 records the refusal as the known 18.0.0 behaviour, not as a FAIL of the item.
- ⛔ No new gate.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, for "checklist item fresh install os migrate apply first birth marker then os serve boots 24827". The only hit is #24827 itself.

Dedupe words: fresh install birth marker; migrate apply first then serve; organization-ownership marker empty database.
